description: This file defines the HelpDesk class, which extends CRMEntity, and manages HelpDesk/Trouble Ticket functionalities in the application. It includes methods for creating, saving, retrieving, exporting, and managing related records, comments, activities, and email content for HelpDesk tickets within the CRM system.

classes.name: HelpDesk
classes.description: Represents the HelpDesk ticket entity, providing methods to manage tickets, related activities, comments, exports, histories, and email formatting within the CRM system.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles additional operations after saving a HelpDesk record, such as inserting comments and attachments.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves related modules and updates helpdesk specifics like HelpDesk related to and service contract states.

methods.name: insertIntoTicketCommentTable
methods.description: Inserts a comment into the vtiger_ticketcomments table for a specific ticket.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Uploads and associates files as attachments to a HelpDesk record.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves related activities (tasks, events) for a specific ticket.

methods.name: get_ticket_history
methods.description: Returns historical update logs for a specific ticket.

methods.name: get_ticket_comments_list
methods.description: Fetches and formats comments related to a ticket.

methods.name: getColumnNames_Hd
methods.description: Returns a list of the HelpDesk module fields in uppercase, free of spaces.

methods.name: getCommentInformation
methods.description: Generates an HTML formatted list of comments for display purposes.

methods.name: getCustomerName
methods.description: Retrieves the customer name associated with the ticket from portal info.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs and returns the SQL query for exporting ticket records with specific conditions.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Fetches and returns the activity history for the ticket.

methods.name: constructUpdateLog
methods.description: Generates a log string describing updates made to a ticket.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records (activities, attachments, notes) from one ticket to another.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Builds the secondary SQL query part used in reports for related data.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Provides table relations for the specified secondary module.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes the relationship between a ticket and related entities such as contacts, accounts, or other modules.

methods.name: getTicketEmailContents
methods.description: Generates email content for a ticket, including details, comments, and related info.

methods.name: getPortalTicketEmailContents
methods.description: Creates email content formatted for customer portal notifications about tickets.

methods.name: clearSingletonSaveFields
methods.description: Resets comment fields for the ticket object.
